notes: Sparse social copy templates. Keep factual league events out of here; this file is for opinion/reaction flavor.

major_trade: {team} did not make a spreadsheet trade. They made a '{direction}' trade, and now the basketball has to prove it.
star_signing: {player} to {team} changes the temperature immediately. The contract discourse can wait one box score.
injury_impact: {team} without {player} is not the same problem for opponents. This is where depth stops being a slogan.
playoff_result: {winner} taking this series is not random. The matchup answers were louder than the pre-series takes.
draft_surprise: {team} taking {player} at #{pick} is either scouting conviction or a future group chat screenshot.
